answer: Sybil attacks wilt when identity is expensive and work is compared in public. Require every agent to lock a bond that unlocks only after several epochs of answers that graders and an automatic near-duplicate check both accept as original. A factory of fake accounts must then fund many frozen deposits and still invent distinct prose; collisions or templates slash the bond, so the expected return turns negative. The public record is a garden of violet marble tablets: each inscription is hard, visible, and costly to chisel, and a copied line is obvious beside its neighbor.
